Why Does Claude Code Compact Your Conversation on Its Own?

Claude Code compacts a conversation when its context is nearly full. Since October 2026, it also compacts after you've been away for about an hour. All 49 of my automatic compactions were the second kind. This post explains the difference, what survives a compaction, and how to control it.

2026-11-25 · Claude Code· About 7 min read

What Is a CLI? Learn How the Terminal Works with Claude Code

A CLI is a way to control a computer by typing commands. Using a web page that was actually built with one typed sentence, this post explains how a CLI differs from a graphical user interface (GUI), why many AI assistants work in the terminal, how Claude Code types commands for you, and which line to read before it touches your files.

2026-11-24 · Getting started· About 11 min read

How to Check Your Antigravity (agy) Quota

Type /usage in the Antigravity CLI, or run agy -p /usage --output-format json to get your quota without calling a model. See which models share each of the two quota pools and when they reset.

2026-11-23 · Antigravity· About 4 min read

Why Did My Codex Weekly Limit Reset Early?

Codex weekly limits often reset days before resets_at because OpenAI runs global resets. Ten weekly periods of data from one Plus account, the official reset rules, and how to check.

2026-11-23 · Codex· About 5 min read

When Does the Claude Code Weekly Limit Reset?

Claude Code's weekly limit resets at a fixed day and time assigned to your account. Here is how that works with the 5-hour limit, and how to see your countdown.

2026-11-23 · Claude Code· About 5 min read
usage

Track your AI coding quotas in the menu bar

usage is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) app for the macOS menu bar and Windows tray, supporting Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse.
